difficulty_reason: Prove the diagonal of the polarized stack is separated and of finite presentation: lfp follows from limit preservation of the stack via the Limits-of-Stacks characterization; separatedness reduces to separatedness of Isom of two polarized objects over affine U, whose forgetful morphism to Isom_U(Y,X) (separated by lemma-Mor-s-lfp and lemma-Isom-in-Mor) has base change Isom(N_T, f^*L_T), affine over U by the section-hom-isom discussion; quasi-compactness reduces to Noetherian affine U via limit presentation, then the chi-locally-constant lemma pins one Hilbert polynomial P on U, the forgetful morphism lands in Isom_U(Y,X) intersect Mor^{P',M}_U(Y,X) for P'(t)=P(2t) - computed via chi(Y_t,(id x f)^* M^{tensor n}) = P(2n) using the polarization isomorphism - the intersection is Noetherian by lemma-Mor-qc-over-base, and the forgetful morphism is affine.
